title: Intelligent In-Vehicle Scenario Orchestration Agent System
summary: Changan reports that its Intelligent In-Vehicle Scenario Orchestration Agent cuts scenario setup from minutes to seconds; it reports no timing study.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A Changan brochure for the Qiyuan E07 SUV, uploaded to the company's GitHub repository on 28 May 2025, markets scenarios that drivers program by voice through an AI large model. In its project account for the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, Changan reports that its vehicle agent demonstration reduces scenario configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. The account states that configuring a scenario typically takes several minutes and needs technical knowledge. It cites the brochure. It lists only a Douyin video as its testbed and reports no timing study. Development continues. No source measures safety or environmental benefits.
purpose: Let drivers coordinate vehicle functions through natural-language commands.
developer: Chongqing Changan Automobile, with Ali Cloud collaboration

ratings.reason: Changan states that scenario setup falls from minutes to seconds, a convenience for drivers. No timing study or independent user study supports the figure.
The makers expect that manufacturers will integrate services more easily. No source measures a gain for any organization.
